apis.signature: pub fn new(data: ArrayD<f32>, requires_grad: bool) -> Self

apis.name: new_pooled
apis.signature: pub fn new_pooled( data: ArrayD<f32>, requires_grad: bool, pool: &crate::memory_pool::TensorPool, ) -> Self

apis.signature: pub fn new_with_dtype(data: ArrayD<f32>, requires_grad: bool, dtype: DType) -> Self

apis.name: apply
apis.signature: pub fn apply(op: Arc<dyn Operation + Send + Sync>, inputs: &[Tensor]) -> Tensor

apis.name: quantized_matmul
notes: I8, rowwise I8, and blockwise I8 weights match explicit dequantized matmul.
Exact gradients to the floating input are verified; quantized weights are inference-only.
Nonquantized, malformed, and dimensionally incompatible weights are rejected.

apis.name: quantize_weights
apis.signature: pub fn quantize_weights( &self, dtype: DType, block_size: Option<usize>, ) -> Result<Tensor, String>
notes: Outputs are detached inference tensors.
Only I8, I8Rowwise, and I8Blockwise are accepted.
Zero block size and non-matrix inputs are rejected without mutating the source.

apis.name: astype
apis.signature: pub fn astype(&self, dtype: DType) -> Tensor
notes: Floating casts preserve the computation graph with identity gradients.
Integer and quantized casts detach because discrete conversion is nondifferentiable.

apis.name: add
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and reduction of broadcast gradients are verified.

apis.name: mul
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and product-rule gradients reduced to both input shapes are verified.

apis.name: sub
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and signed reduction of broadcast gradients are verified.

apis.name: div
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and quotient-rule gradients reduced to both input shapes are verified.
Division by zero follows IEEE f32 behavior.

apis.name: matmul
notes: Rectangular rank-2, N-D by rank-2, and matching-prefix N-D forward multiplication and exact gradients are verified.
Inner dimensions must match; two N-D operands require identical batch prefixes and do not support batch broadcasting.

apis.name: batched_matmul
notes: Independent rank-3 batches and exact gradients for both operands are verified.
Batch dimensions and inner dimensions must match; batch broadcasting is not supported.

apis.name: pow
apis.signature: pub fn pow(&self, power: f32) -> Tensor
notes: Fractional positive-domain powers and analytical gradients are verified.

apis.name: sum
notes: Global scalar reduction and unit gradient expansion are verified.

apis.name: sum_axis
apis.signature: pub fn sum_axis(&self, axis: isize, keep_dims: bool) -> Tensor
notes: Negative axes, keep-dim output, and backward expansion are verified.
Invalid axes are rejected.

apis.name: cumsum
apis.signature: pub fn cumsum(&self, dim: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Reverse cumulative gradient accumulation is verified.

apis.name: cumprod
apis.signature: pub fn cumprod(&self, dim: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Product-rule gradients, including zero-valued inputs, are verified.

apis.name: cummax
apis.signature: pub fn cummax(&self, dim: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Each prefix gradient routes to its first maximum winner.

apis.name: cummin
apis.signature: pub fn cummin(&self, dim: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Each prefix gradient routes to its first minimum winner.

apis.name: exp
notes: Forward and self-derivative behavior are verified.

apis.name: log
notes: Positive-domain values and reciprocal gradients are verified.
Zero and negative inputs follow IEEE f32 behavior.

apis.name: rmsnorm
apis.signature: pub fn rmsnorm(&self, gamma: &Tensor, axis: usize, eps: f32) -> Tensor
notes: Input and gamma gradients are verified by central finite differences.
Non-last normalized axes are verified.
Axis, epsilon, and gamma shape are validated.

apis.name: swiglu
notes: Forward and weighted analytical gradients are verified.
Scalar and odd-width inputs are rejected.

apis.name: embedding_lookup
notes: Repeated indices accumulate embedding gradients.
Index gradients are zero.
Public inputs require finite non-negative integral in-range indices.

apis.name: embedding_bag
apis.signature: pub fn embedding_bag(emb: &Tensor, indices: &Tensor, offsets: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Sum mode and repeated-row gradient accumulation are verified.
Index and offset gradients are zero.
Offsets must be integral, nondecreasing, and within the index array.

apis.name: unfold2d
apis.signature: pub fn unfold2d( &self, kernel_h: usize, kernel_w: usize, stride: usize, padding: usize, ) -> Tensor
notes: Padding, stride, exact patch layout, and overlapping gradient accumulation are verified.
Impossible or overflowing geometry is rejected before allocation.

apis.name: fold2d
apis.signature: pub fn fold2d( &self, output_h: usize, output_w: usize, kernel_h: usize, kernel_w: usize, stride: usize, padding: usize, ) -> Tensor
notes: Non-overlap reconstruction, overlap-add, and weighted gradients are verified.
Channel and column geometry are validated before execution.

apis.name: equal
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and zero gradients are verified.

apis.name: greater
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and zero gradients are verified.

apis.name: less
notes: Mixed-rank broadcasting and zero gradients are verified.

apis.name: where_select
apis.signature: pub fn where_select(condition: &Tensor, x: &Tensor, y: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Branch gradients reduce across broadcast dimensions; condition gradients are zero.

apis.name: masked_fill
apis.signature: pub fn masked_fill(&self, mask: &Tensor, value: f32) -> Tensor
notes: Gradients pass only through unmasked input values.

apis.name: masked_scatter
apis.signature: pub fn masked_scatter(&self, mask: &Tensor, source: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Row-major source consumption and exact base/source gradient routing are verified.
Extra source values receive zero gradient.
Short sources leave trailing selected positions unchanged.

apis.name: index_select
apis.signature: pub fn index_select(&self, dim: usize, indices: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Repeated indices accumulate input gradients.
Output uses canonical contiguous logical order.

apis.name: gather
apis.signature: pub fn gather(&self, dim: usize, index: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Repeated indices accumulate input gradients.
Index rank, shape, integrality, and bounds are validated.

apis.name: scatter
apis.signature: pub fn scatter(&self, dim: usize, index: &Tensor, src: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Duplicate destinations use last-write-wins in both forward and backward.
Overwritten base and source entries receive zero gradient.

apis.name: scatter_add
apis.signature: pub fn scatter_add(&self, dim: usize, index: &Tensor, src: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Duplicate destinations accumulate values and route gradient to every additive source.

apis.name: fft
notes: Last-axis DFT, batched execution, roundtrip, and weighted gradients are verified.

apis.name: ifft
notes: The operation returns the real inverse DFT under the documented complex-pair representation.

apis.name: rfft
notes: Even-length half-spectrum output, roundtrip, and weighted gradients are verified.

apis.name: irfft
notes: Input half-spectrum length m reconstructs the documented even length 2*(m-1).
Half-spectrum lengths below two are rejected.

apis.name: complex_conj
notes: Exact forward conjugation and sign-flipped imaginary gradients are verified.

apis.name: complex_mul
notes: Exact paired-real complex multiplication and both weighted gradients are verified.
Inputs must have identical shape and a trailing axis of size two.

apis.name: kvcache_append
apis.signature: pub fn kvcache_append(cache: &Tensor, new_kv: &Tensor, axis: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Forward concatenation and exact weighted gradient splitting are verified.
Rank, axis, and non-axis dimensions are strictly validated.

apis.name: neg
notes: Exact elementwise negation and weighted negative gradients are verified.

apis.name: relu
notes: The derivative at zero is defined as zero.

apis.name: ternary
notes: Forward emits {-mean_abs, 0, mean_abs}; backward intentionally uses an identity STE.
Empty inputs are rejected because their quantization scale is undefined.

apis.name: sigmoid
notes: Analytical gradients and finite behavior at inputs -100 and 100 are verified.

apis.name: tanh
notes: Analytical gradients and finite behavior at inputs -100 and 100 are verified.

apis.name: gelu
notes: The tanh approximation with coefficient 0.044715 and its analytical gradient are verified.

apis.name: silu
notes: Analytical gradients and finite behavior at inputs -100 and 100 are verified.

apis.name: mean
notes: Global scalar reduction and exact 1/N gradient scaling are verified.

apis.name: max
notes: Exact ties split gradients evenly.
Nearby but unequal values are not treated as ties.

apis.name: min
notes: Exact ties split gradients evenly.
Nearby but unequal values are not treated as ties.

apis.name: det
notes: Square matrices and leading batch dimensions are verified.
Backward uses cofactors and remains correct for singular matrices.
Non-square inputs are rejected.

apis.name: inv
notes: Square matrices, leading batch dimensions, and analytical inverse gradients are verified.
Non-square and singular matrices are rejected.

apis.name: clamp
apis.signature: pub fn clamp(&self, min_val: f32, max_val: f32) -> Tensor
notes: Autograd is preserved.
Gradient is one inside the inclusive bounds and zero outside.
Reversed bounds are rejected.

apis.name: sqrt
notes: Positive-domain values and 1/(2*sqrt(x)) gradients are verified.
Zero and negative inputs follow IEEE f32 behavior.

apis.name: slice_channels
apis.signature: pub fn slice_channels(&self, start: usize, count: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Selected channels preserve autograd and gradients route only to their source range.
Invalid ranks, overflowing ranges, and out-of-bounds ranges are rejected.

apis.name: softmax
apis.signature: pub fn softmax(&self, axis: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Last and non-last axes and the full Jacobian-vector product are verified.
Extreme logits and all-negative-infinity lanes remain finite.
Invalid axes are rejected.

apis.name: log_softmax
apis.signature: pub fn log_softmax(&self, axis: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Last and non-last axes and analytical gradients are verified.
Backward derives probabilities from logits.
Extreme logits and all-negative-infinity lanes remain finite.

apis.name: upsample_nearest2d
apis.signature: pub fn upsample_nearest2d(&self, scale: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Integer nearest-neighbor replication and exact weighted gradient accumulation are verified.
Zero scale, invalid rank, and output-dimension overflow are rejected.

apis.name: interpolate
apis.signature: pub fn interpolate(&self, size: (usize, usize), mode: String, align_corners: bool) -> Tensor
notes: NCHW nearest and bilinear modes are verified.
Nearest exact replication and gradient accumulation are verified.
Bilinear align_corners=true coordinates and analytical gradients are verified.
Additional shapes and align_corners=false bilinear cases remain under review.

apis.name: grid_sample
apis.signature: pub fn grid_sample( &self, grid: &Tensor, mode: String, padding_mode: String, align_corners: bool, ) -> Tensor
notes: NCHW input and NHW2 normalized grids are verified.
Bilinear input and grid gradients are verified analytically.
Nearest grid gradients are zero, as expected almost everywhere.
Zeros and border padding are supported; reflection padding is explicitly rejected.
Additional ranks are not supported.

apis.name: cross_entropy_with_logits
apis.signature: pub fn cross_entropy_with_logits(&self, target: &Tensor, axis: isize) -> Tensor
notes: Mean reduction with index, one-hot, and soft categorical targets is verified.
Positive, negative, last, and non-last class axes are verified.
Stable log-sum-exp remains finite for logits with magnitude 10000.
Invalid axes and non-integral or out-of-range labels are rejected.

apis.name: topk
apis.signature: pub fn topk(&self, k: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Output concatenates descending values then f32 indices along the last axis.
Ties are stable and only the values half contributes gradients.
Excessive k and scalar inputs are rejected.

apis.name: sort
notes: Stable ascending last-axis ordering and inverse-permutation gradients are verified.

apis.name: argsort
notes: Stable ascending last-axis indices are returned as f32; gradients are zero.

apis.name: softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits
apis.signature: pub fn softmax_cross_entropy_with_logits(&self, target: &Tensor, axis: isize) -> Tensor
notes: Matches cross_entropy_with_logits for index targets.
Mean reduction and analytical logits gradients are verified.
One-hot and soft categorical gradient formulas account for target mass.
Stable log-sum-exp remains finite for logits with magnitude 10000.

apis.name: nll_loss
notes: Mean reduction with last-axis classes is verified.
Index and one-hot targets produce identical forward values and gradients.
Targets are non-differentiable.
Higher-rank inputs remain under review.

apis.name: binary_cross_entropy
notes: Element-wise output; no reduction is applied.
Boundary probabilities are clamped with f32::EPSILON.
Broadcasting behavior remains under review.

apis.name: binary_cross_entropy_with_logits
notes: Element-wise output; no reduction is applied.
Forward and backward remain finite for logits at -100 and 100.
Broadcasting behavior remains under review.

apis.name: layer_norm
apis.signature: pub fn layer_norm(&self, axis: usize, eps: f32, gamma: &Tensor, beta: &Tensor) -> Tensor
notes: Input, gamma, and beta gradients are verified by central finite differences.
Non-last normalized axes and gradient permutation are verified.
Axis, epsilon, gamma shape, and beta shape are validated.

apis.name: batch_norm
apis.signature: pub fn batch_norm( &self, gamma: &Tensor, beta: &Tensor, running_mean: &Tensor, running_var: &Tensor, config: BatchNormConfig, ) -> Tensor
notes: Training and evaluation behavior matches the scalar-parameter wrapper.
Input, gamma, and beta gradients and running-statistic updates are verified.
Channel parameter shapes, reduction dimensions, momentum, epsilon, and running variance are validated.

apis.name: batch_norm_with_params
apis.signature: pub fn batch_norm_with_params( &self, gamma: &Tensor, beta: &Tensor, running_mean: &Tensor, running_var: &Tensor, momentum: f32, eps: f32, training: bool, ) -> Tensor
notes: Training and evaluation modes are verified.
Input, gamma, and beta gradients are verified analytically.
Running mean and variance receive zero gradients.
Training updates running statistics; evaluation leaves them unchanged.
Equivalent to batch_norm with an explicit BatchNormConfig.
Higher ranks and parameter-shape broadcasting remain under review.

apis.name: reshape
apis.signature: pub fn reshape(&self, shape: Vec<usize>) -> Result<Tensor, String>
notes: Logical element order and exact inverse-shape gradient routing are verified.
Element-count mismatches return an error.
Higher-rank reshape chains remain under review.

apis.name: transpose
notes: Transpose reverses all axes.
The operation is implemented through canonical autograd-aware permutation.
Exact inverse-transpose gradient routing is verified.

apis.name: permute
apis.signature: pub fn permute(&self, perm: Vec<usize>) -> Tensor
notes: Three-dimensional forward layout and inverse-permutation gradients are verified exactly.
Permutation length, bounds, and uniqueness are validated.

apis.name: rope
apis.signature: pub fn rope(&self, num_heads: usize, theta: f32, scale: f32, offset: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Interleaved rotary pairs use the penultimate input axis as sequence.
Configured theta, scale, and offset are honored identically in forward and backward.
Backward applies the exact transpose/inverse rotation.

apis.name: concat
apis.signature: pub fn concat(tensors: &[Tensor], axis: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Concatenation along axes 0 and 1 is verified.
Backward gradients split exactly at unequal input boundaries.
Empty inputs, invalid axes, rank mismatches, and incompatible dimensions are rejected.

apis.name: stack
apis.signature: pub fn stack(tensors: &[Tensor], axis: usize) -> Tensor
notes: Stacking along new axes 0 and 1 is verified.
Backward removes the inserted axis and routes exact gradients to each input.
Empty inputs, invalid axes, and unequal input shapes are rejected.

apis.name: build_topo
apis.signature: pub fn build_topo( &self, visited: &mut std::collections::HashSet<*const Mutex<TensorData>>, topo_order: &mut Vec<Tensor>, )
